name: HaloDomeHouse_06
note: HouseA (24 x 22 x 26, tall). Round tower R 7.2, two storeys (double arched door + two flank windows below; a big centre window flanked by two small ones above the awning), lantern pedestals, blue/mint awning, two front pots, ribbed gold dome straight on the cornice. Heights are squeezed to fit the 26-stud plan (the 2D tower is ~34 studs tall). Missing: the balcony with a gold balustrade and flower pots between the storeys, window boxes, topiary cones + ivy beside the pots, small gold ball finials on the corner posts (see generator_gaps.md). Built from art/review/img3/HaloDomeHouse_06_check.jpg (2D panel); the 2D PNG and side view are not in the worktree.
